description: The same design at several widths, with what to multiply the initialization and the learning rate by at each, following Tensor Programs V. Sweep hyperparameters at the narrow end and carry the answer up: a learning rate tuned at the base rung is the right one at every rung, scaled per class. Every rung is saved as a design of its own, ready to analyze or generate. It does not choose a learning rate; that is what the sweep is for.

base_width.description: The width the sweep happens at. Omit for the narrowest.

design_id.description: Handle returned by tensorcad_new_design or tensorcad_open_design, e.g. "dsn_1".

widths.description: The widths to build. Omit to halve the design's own width down to a width worth sweeping at.

name: tensorcad_mup

head_dim.description: Held fixed while the width moves: the heads get more numerous, not wider.

design_id.description: The rung, saved in this session.

multiplier.description: Width over the base width: the m every rule is written in.

adam_lr.description: Multiplies the base model's learning rate.

init_std.description: Multiplies the base model's initialization standard deviation.

title: Build a width ladder
